patterns.not_admitting: Starts:\s*(This programme is not offered to new students|Not offered to new students(?:.|\n){0,40}?)\s*(?:Key semester dates|Fees|\.)

config.notes: AUT course pages (www.aut.ac.nz/study/study-options/<area>/courses/<slug> and www.aut.ac.nz/courses/<slug>) carry a Key facts panel: "Programme code: AKxxxx Level: N Points: N Duration: ... Campus: ... Starts: 22 Feb 2027 12 Jul 2027 Key semester dates Fees Domestic $.. (for N points) (...) International [2026 fee:] $.. (for N points) ($N tuition fees + $N student services levy)", then "English language requirements IELTS (Academic) 6.5 overall with all bands 6.0 or higher". Fee = international tuition (student services levy excluded) only when stated for 120 points (one full-time year); where two years are printed the newer (2027) international line is read and its year kept (5 Oct 13:02), otherwise the single line (year kept when printed); 60/180/240-point figures, per-major split figures (e.g. "Computing: $..") and "Not offered to new students" lines are not read. Level = NZQF level (kept as aqf_level, testing only). not_admitting = "Starts: This programme is not offered to new students". Arion (arion.aut.ac.nz) paper/qualification pages, online.aut.ac.nz pages and old PDF programme guides carry none of these. Semester dates: https://www.aut.ac.nz/study/semester-dates (S1 = February, S2 = July, Summer School = November); business professional masters trimesters: https://www.aut.ac.nz/study/semester-dates/business-professional-masters-programmes-dates (T1 = March, T2 = June, T3 = October). Mode (delivery) = the Key facts "Campus:" value, which is where the course page prints delivery (e.g. "City Campus", "City Campus Online study", "South Campus Distance learning"); the earlier mode pattern read study load (full-time/part-time) and was replaced. online.aut.ac.nz pages (ON-coded AUT Online pages, domestic fees only) print "Delivery: 100% online" but are not read for mode because they are a different programme page from the bound AK course. International view (5 Oct 13:02): the AUT course page prints domestic and international figures together in Key facts (no separate international address or toggle found in stored pages), so no page_view is needed; 13 courses bound to Arion, PDF, repository or wrong pages were moved to their own course pages. Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22, shown in Coverage for review, never admitted): the Key facts page section "Minimum entry requirements" (up to about 200 characters, ending at "International student entry requirements", "English language requirements", "Other requirements" or "Selection criteria"); the international panel ("International student entry requirements") adds only English and other requirements to it. Pages whose minimum requirement is worded for New Zealand qualifications ("If you have New Zealand qualifications ... If you have qualifications from another country See entry requirements for students from other countries") and minimum requirements stated only as New Zealand school qualifications (University Entrance, NCEA, Year 12/13) are not read, because the international requirement is on a separate by-country page. Exit awards (5 Oct 15:22): three postgraduate pages say only "available as an exit qualification" / "you can exit with ..." with no full-time years, so no exit_awards pattern is set. Whole-course fees: the only whole-programme figures are online.aut.ac.nz domestic-only fees ("not available for international students"), so no fee_total pattern is set.
